query_snapshot: For potassium hydroxide solution below 70 percent, which barriers does the archived NIOSH table place in its 8-hour group and which in its 4-hour group?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- The archived NIOSH table places Butyl in the >8-hour (8-hour) barrier group for potassium hydroxide solution below 70%. [1988 OSHA PEL Project - Potassium Hydroxide | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/pel88/1310-58.html]
- The archived NIOSH table places Nitrile in the >8-hour (8-hour) barrier group for potassium hydroxide solution below 70%. [1988 OSHA PEL Project - Potassium Hydroxide | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/pel88/1310-58.html]
- The archived NIOSH table places Neoprene in the >8-hour (8-hour) barrier group for potassium hydroxide solution below 70%. [1988 OSHA PEL Project - Potassium Hydroxide | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/pel88/1310-58.html]
- The archived NIOSH table places Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) in the >8-hour (8-hour) barrier group for potassium hydroxide solution below 70%. [1988 OSHA PEL Project - Potassium Hydroxide | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/pel88/1310-58.html]
- The archived NIOSH table places Viton in the >8-hour (8-hour) barrier group for potassium hydroxide solution below 70%. [1988 OSHA PEL Project - Potassium Hydroxide | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/pel88/1310-58.html]
- The archived NIOSH table lists Barrier® as a >8-hour (8-hour) breakthrough glove/barrier for potassium hydroxide solution below 70%. [1988 OSHA PEL Project - Potassium Hydroxide | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/pel88/1310-58.html]
- The archived NIOSH table lists Tychem® BR, Responder®, and TK as protective clothing materials with >8-hour breakthrough for potassium hydroxide solution below 70%. [1988 OSHA PEL Project - Potassium Hydroxide | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/pel88/1310-58.html]
